# Vocabulary

Namespace `http://archaeology.link/ontology/qskos#` (placeholder, to be replaced by a persistent IRI before release).

## Classes

### qskos:Annotation

Assigns the value concepts (oa:hasBody) of an annotation field (qskos:attribute) to a feature (oa:hasTarget). As an E13 it carries who and when (P14, P4).

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E13_Attribute_Assignment`, `oa:Annotation`
- **In an export:** One per feature and annotation field that has a value. Several selected concepts in one cell become several `oa:hasBody` values on the same annotation. `dct:creator` is the creator field, `dct:created` the export time.

### qskos:Catalog

Curated collection of QSKOS datasets of one institution or project.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E73_Information_Object`, `dcat:Catalog`
- **In an export:** One per export file. Groups the dataset(s) of that file; a place to hang institution-level metadata later.

### qskos:Dataset

One export package (typically one GeoPackage = one object documentation) with at least one feature layer. Carries the DCAT metadata (title, licence, creator, version) and points to the vocabularies it needs (dct:requires). Layers are dct:hasPart of the dataset.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E73_Information_Object`, `dcat:Dataset`
- **In an export:** One per export run: title, licence and creator come from the three fields of the LOD Export tab, the issue date from the export time. `dct:subject` points to every mapped object, `dct:hasPart` to every layer, `dct:requires` to every vocabulary scheme the layers are bound to.

### qskos:Distribution

A concrete file of a dataset: the Turtle export.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E73_Information_Object`, `dcat:Distribution`
- **In an export:** Describes the Turtle file itself (media type, file name).

### qskos:Feature

Region, line or point on a 2D derivative of the object. On the CRM side an E53 Place positioned relative to the object (crm:P157); deliberately not E26, which would say that the polygon IS the damage. crmgeo:SP6 is left out: CRMgeo makes it a subclass of geo:Geometry as well, and geo:Feature and geo:Geometry are disjoint in GeoSPARQL.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E53_Place`, `geo:Feature`, `oa:SpecificResource`
- **In an export:** One per QGIS feature, annotated or not. Its IRI is built from the object ID, the layer name and the `uuid` column if the layer has one, else the QGIS feature id (stable only while the GeoPackage rows are not re-created).

### qskos:FeatureLayer

One QGIS layer of the GeoPackage (one geometry type plus an annotation-field schema). SPARQLing Unicorn imports a geo:FeatureCollection with rdfs:member as one layer.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E73_Information_Object`, `geo:FeatureCollection`
- **In an export:** One per QGIS layer that has an Object ID. Lists its features with `rdfs:member`, its configured annotation fields with `qskos:hasAttribute`, and its vocabulary bindings with `qskos:usesVocabulary`.

### qskos:FieldConcept

Role of a vocabulary concept as an annotation field. Derived, never asserted on publisher IRIs: every object of qskos:attribute.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E55_Type`, `skos:Concept`
- **In an export:** A role, not something the plugin writes: every object of `qskos:attribute`. Defined for reasoners and documentation; it is never asserted on publisher IRIs.

### qskos:Geometry

Geometry as a GeoSPARQL WKT literal prefixed with a CRS IRI (object-local or EPSG). Also a Web Annotation selector.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E73_Information_Object`, `geo:Geometry`, `oa:Selector`
- **In an export:** The feature's geometry as `geo:asWKT` with the CRS IRI in front of the WKT, plus the matching `sf:` type (Polygon, Point, ...). Written only for features that have a geometry.

### qskos:LocalCoordinateSystem

Technical CRS of an orthomosaic or DEM, defined by surveyed control points of the photographic plate. Must be resolvable.

- **Superclasses:** `crmgeo:SP4_Spatial_Coordinate_Reference_System`
- **In an export:** Written only when the 'object-local coordinate system' box is ticked: one per layer. Without the box the layer's EPSG code is used as CRS IRI and no local CRS node is written.

### qskos:MappedObject

The physical object. Instances additionally carry the CRM class chosen at export time (E19, E22, ... all below E18).

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E18_Physical_Thing`
- **In an export:** Created once per Object ID of the LOD Export tab. Also typed with the CRM class chosen in the dropdown (an E18 subclass).

### qskos:ValueConcept

Role of a concept chosen as a value. Derived: every object of oa:hasBody of a qskos:Annotation.

- **Superclasses:** `crm:E55_Type`, `skos:Concept`
- **In an export:** A role, not something the plugin writes: every object of `oa:hasBody` of a `qskos:Annotation`.

## Properties

### qskos:attribute

The concept that defines the annotation field. Stored per annotation because skos:broaderTransitive cannot reconstruct in which field a value was recorded.

- **Domain:** `qskos:Annotation`
- **Range:** `skos:Concept`
- **Sub-property of:** `crm:P177_assigned_property_of_type`
- **In an export:** The annotation field (a concept IRI; in the plugin the layer's column name is that IRI).

### qskos:definedByRaster



- **Domain:** `qskos:LocalCoordinateSystem`
- **Range:** `xsd:string`
- **In an export:** File name of the raster that defines the local CRS, if the adapter is given one (currently not filled by the UI).

### qskos:hasAttribute

Layer schema: the configured field concepts, even where no annotation exists yet.

- **Domain:** `qskos:FeatureLayer`
- **Range:** `skos:Concept`
- **In an export:** Layer schema: all configured fields, also those that have no annotation yet.

### qskos:inCoordinateSystem

Explicit, machine-readable binding of a geometry to its local CRS, in addition to the IRI prefix in the WKT literal (which only SPARQLing Unicorn parses). Candidate for alignment with crmgeo:Q9_is_expressed_in_terms_of once SP5 is settled.

- **Domain:** `qskos:Geometry`
- **Range:** `qskos:LocalCoordinateSystem`
- **In an export:** Only in local-CRS exports: the explicit link from a geometry to its `qskos:LocalCoordinateSystem`.

### qskos:usesVocabulary

Vocabulary binding of the layer (qskos_layer_config in the GeoPackage).

- **Domain:** `qskos:FeatureLayer`
- **Range:** `skos:ConceptScheme`
- **In an export:** The concept schemes bound to the layer in the GeoPackage (`qskos_layer_config`).

## Reused terms

No metadata property is reinvented: `dct:title`, `dct:description`, `dct:creator`, `dct:license`, `dct:issued`, `dct:hasPart`, `dct:requires`, `dct:subject`, `dct:conformsTo`, `dcat:dataset`, `dcat:distribution`, `dcat:mediaType`, `dcat:version`, `geo:hasGeometry`, `geo:asWKT`, `rdfs:member`, `oa:hasTarget`, `oa:hasBody`, `oa:hasSource`, `oa:hasSelector`, `oa:motivatedBy`, `as:generator`, `crm:P157_is_at_rest_relative_to`.
